title: Update one top-level field
summary: By default, set merges the supplied top-level fields into state.
introduction: By default, set merges the supplied top-level fields into state. Your task: Update name without changing count.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for update one top-level field

blocks.text: By default, set merges the supplied top-level fields into state. Fields that are not supplied stay as they were.
Use a React project with Zustand 5 installed. Hook examples belong in React components; vanilla examples use zustand/vanilla. These package imports require your own build tool.
Read the code step by step

items: setState supplies a new count without replacing the whole state.
The untouched name field remains available because the default update is a shallow merge.

blocks.text: The name is still Garden after count changes.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: The merge is shallow. It does not automatically merge all levels inside a nested object.
